# Gramlot examples 0.2.15

- Add c20: button action, action with native ask fields, conditional action/controller confirmations, dictionary _if, legacy askIf, and local Source/DOM references.
- Add c21: plain html_button reset, immediate and delayed versions of the same action, grouped click counts, a delayed named controller and delayed confirmation.
- Keep the learning sequence explicit: c20 covers core 0.2.18; c21 introduces the core 0.2.19 button additions. All pages have Python and JavaScript versions and short practical explanations.
- Require Gramlot >=0.2.19 in Python and JavaScript. The gallery and manual now cover 45 lessons.

The new lessons passed Chromium and WebKit with Python, Node and direct-file serverless output, including confirmation/cancellation, conditional execution, reference resolution, native reset and delayed counts. JavaScript/Python suites and strict documentation coverage/link checks passed.
